howToPlay: Emz is a controller who uses hairspray to damage enemies and push them away with her gadgets. Use her super to create toxic clouds that slow down and damage opponents while she keeps her distance. Focus on maintaining control of the map by zoning enemies out of key areas.
gears: Damage is excellent for increasing her output while low on health, while Shield adds survivability. Speed is ideal for maps with many bushes to help her position for better range.
trait: This brawler suits a strategic player who enjoys area control and keeping distance from aggressive opponents.
